column1: # Shin Kong Financial investor decks, addressed one by one.
# The index is unreachable and the filenames are not constructible — the older
# host names them by title plus a random suffix, the newer one by upload
# timestamp — so a walk of conference ids finds nothing and there is no listing
# to read. What IS enumerable is the Wayback Machine's record of the two file
# stores, prefix-queried: fourteen decks, 2017 to 2024, every one of which the
# relay fetches at 200 from the live host.
# That is not the full conference history. It is roughly annual, and annual is
# exactly the chain-link's tolerance (MAX_GAP_Q = 4), so it is enough to carry
# Shin Kong Life through the years it was missing rather than leave the hole.
# wayback_ts is the capture the CDX index proves returned the PDF, used only
# when the live fetch fails, so a host outage does not cost the harvest.
# conf_id  the vendor's event id, kept for provenance
# label    what the file is called, which is where its as-of date comes from
